design_concept: Utilitarian Contractor Paperwork Engine (Field-Service High Glare)
emotional_tone: Built to be read in direct harsh daylight on a jobsite phone with dusty thumbs or work gloves. Sturdy, monolithic, utilitarian, zero consumer-app fluff.

user_context.viewport_widen_strategy: Mobile single column (max-w-md mx-auto) widening to desktop max-w-5xl with balanced utilitarian grid layouts without altering data flow or routes.
user_context.touch_target_rule: Strict min-height 48px on all interactive elements: buttons, inputs, tabs, row items, status selectors.
user_context.trade_context: Solo contractors and small trade crews managing estimates, logs, receipts, client histories, and rate cards.

forbidden_styles: No gradients anywhere (no gradient buttons, no gradient overlays, no gradient text)
No drop shadows anywhere (box-shadow is completely disabled/removed)
No rounded corners larger than 8px (max border-radius 8px for inputs and buttons; 6px recommended for status pills and compact elements)
No cards on non-discrete objects (card styling ONLY on discrete objects like jobs or client records)
No borders that do not separate two genuinely distinct things
No emoji or decorative stock icons anywhere in labels, badges, or buttons
No orange or hues outside the defined 7-color palette
No Inter for headings or numerals
No separate monospace font for numbers — use single industrial sans with tabular-nums
No transparent background in header, nav, dialogs, dropdowns, or overlays

typography.font_family_justification: IBM Plex Sans is an authentic industrial grotesque engineered specifically for high legibility, technical documentation, and mechanical clarity. Unlike condensed poster faces (which fail body legibility at 15px) or playful rounded typefaces, IBM Plex Sans excels uniformly across giant hero dollar displays (32-36px), readable body text (15-16px), and dense table rows. When paired with 'font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "tnum";', its figures are strictly monospaced and align columns flawlessly.
typography.font_family_css: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

rules.single_family_throughout: All headings, body text, buttons, labels, and numbers use IBM Plex Sans.
rules.tabular_nums_rule: All numeric figures, dollar amounts, hours, rates, dates, and percentages must have tabular-nums applied ('tabular-nums' class or inline font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
rules.dollar_hierarchy_rule: Dollar amounts are the LARGEST text on any screen they appear on: Job totals and profit figures at 28-36px minimum; hero money at 32-36px; card money at 24-28px.
rules.label_rule: Labels above numbers are small (11-12px), uppercase, letter-spaced (tracking-wider or tracking-widest), and secondary warm grey (#A39990).
rules.body_text_rule: Body text is never below 15px (15px to 16px), leading-relaxed, in primary warm grey (#F0EAE2) or secondary warm grey (#A39990).

thin.description: Amber for thin profit margin (profit_pct >= 5% and < 20%).

losing.description: Red for losing money or negative margin (profit_pct < 5% or negative profit).

job_status_pill_system.rules: Built strictly from the allowed palette (near-black, elevated surface, bone, signal blue, profit green/amber/red). Status pills are solid filled shapes with readable contrast, not outlined text.

spacing_scale.touch_targets: min-h-[48px] on all clickable items, inputs, and tabs

stat_tiles.rule: Stat tiles show the number large with a small uppercase label above it — NO icons, NO borders, separated by whitespace alone.
stat_tiles.container: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-0 bg-transparent border-0
stat_tiles.tile_item: flex flex-col justify-start border-0 p-0 bg-transparent space-y-1
stat_tiles.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[#A39990]

stat_tiles.value_profit_healthy: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2EB872] tabular-nums leading-none

stat_tiles.value_profit_losing: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#E04838] tabular-nums leading-none

job_card.rule: A job card reads strictly in sequence: 1) Client name large, 2) Address small and secondary, 3) Money figures large, 4) Status pill filled. No drop shadow, subtle border only (#2E2A24).
job_card.container: block bg-[#1C1A17] border border-[#2E2A24] hover:border-[#3D3830] rounded-[8px] p-4 transition-colors
job_card.address: text-xs text-[#A39990] mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5
job_card.money_row: grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-[#2E2A24]

status_pills.rule: Filled shapes with readable contrast, rounded-[6px], not outlined text.
status_pills.classes: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-[6px]

1_login.primary_action: Solid bone button (#F5F1EA) with #12110F text and 52px height
1_login.inputs: Elevated or core input with #3D3830 border and 2px #2F7DE1 focus ring

2_dashboard.header_cta: New Job button styled as primary action in solid bone (#F5F1EA) with near-black text
2_dashboard.stat_tiles_layout: 4 tiles separated by whitespace alone (no borders, no cards, no icons): Open Estimates, Approved Work, Unbilled Expenses, Profit This Month.
2_dashboard.job_groups: Grouped by status: Lead, Estimated, Approved, In Progress, Complete, Invoiced, Paid. Each card follows: client name (large) -> address (small secondary) -> money (largest) -> status pill (filled).

3_job_detail.header_card: Discrete object in #1C1A17 with #2E2A24 border. Displays job number, title, client name, address, tap-to-call link in Signal Blue (#2F7DE1), and status pill dropdown.
3_job_detail.metric_pills: Contract total, costs to date, and profit figure with margin % (healthy green >=20%, thin amber 5-19%, losing red <5%).
3_job_detail.tabs: Tabs in #12110F with #1C1A17 active state and #2F7DE1 text/indicator.
3_job_detail.estimate_tab: Table/list with tabular numerals. Grand total displayed in hero money format (32-36px). Save button in solid bone (#F5F1EA).
3_job_detail.log_tab: Field log timestamped notes with camera upload button. Crew hours collapsible list.
3_job_detail.expenses_tab: Total costs hero number, expense log form with receipt attachment, and line list.

4_clients.list_items: Client cards in #1C1A17 with #2E2A24 border. Direct call button in Signal Blue (#2F7DE1).
4_clients.lifetime_revenue_card: Shows lifetime paid revenue in 36px tabular figures.

5_rate_card.table_layout: Categorized sections (labor, material, equipment, disposal). Inline-editable item names and tabular numeric price fields.
5_rate_card.unconfirmed_banner: Amber-tinted warning notice using #E0A238 and #1C1A17 background.
5_rate_card.actions: Checkmark button confirms price (turns #2EB872 when confirmed).

6_settings.form_card: #1C1A17 surface with #2E2A24 border. Logo upload square, business inputs, tax rate, payment instructions.
6_settings.save_button: Solid bone primary action button (#F5F1EA) with #12110F text.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, status badge, and monetary field MUST retain or include its kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly honor the user's exact color specifications: Near-black background (#12110F), elevated surfaces (#1C1A17), primary warm grey text (#F0EAE2), secondary warm grey text (#A39990).
Primary button must be SOLID BONE (#F5F1EA) with near-black text (#12110F). It is the highest-emphasis element on any screen. Do NOT use Signal Blue for primary buttons.

Signal blue (#2F7DE1) is the interactive accent ONLY: links, active tab indicator, active bottom nav icon, focus rings (2px blue), checkbox/toggle on-states, and chart marks. Never use bone for links.

Profit margin colors: Green (#2EB872) for healthy margin (>= 20%), Amber (#E0A238) for thin margin (5-19%), Red (#E04838) for losing money (< 5% or negative profit). No orange, and NO other hue outside this palette anywhere.

Typography: Use ONE single industrial sans throughout ('IBM Plex Sans'). Remove the condensed font Barlow and remove JetBrains Mono. Set all numeric amounts with tabular-nums so columns and dollar figures align.
Dollar amounts must be the largest text on any screen they appear on: job totals and profit figures at 28-36px minimum.
Stat tiles on the dashboard: show the number large with a small uppercase label above it — NO icons, NO borders, separated by whitespace alone.
Job cards: Must follow the exact order: client name (large) -> address (small secondary) -> money figures (largest) -> status pill (filled). Subtle border only (#2E2A24). No drop shadows.
Remove all drop shadows, all gradients, rounded corners larger than 8px (max 8px, 6px for pills), and all emoji.
Vertical spacing scale: strictly 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px. Tap targets at least 48px tall.
Do NOT alter any routes, API calls, data structures, or state logic. This is purely a design system replacement pass.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.do_not_add_gradients: Gradients are strictly prohibited across buttons, cards, headers, and backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.do_not_add_shadows: Drop shadows are completely forbidden. Rely on surface contrast (#12110F vs #1C1A17) and 1px crisp borders (#2E2A24).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.respect_contrast: Ensure #F0EAE2 and #A39990 text meet high-contrast accessibility standards on both #12110F and #1C1A17 surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.preserve_testids: Never remove, rename, or omit data-testid attributes from components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.touch_accessibility: Maintain min-h-[48px] on all clickable items for one-handed operation on mobile devices in outdoor field environments.
